name: SPARK Makerspace
summary: A community-driven 501(c)(3) in New London emphasising art and local empowerment — woodshop, printmaking, fiber arts and stained glass.

operations.hours_note: Member access 6am–10pm daily. Weekly public meetups (Open Sew, electronics) on a $5 suggested donation.

sources.note: Superseded Google Site, recovered 2026-08-28 from its still-live sites.google.com address. Street address, website and descriptive text are transcribed from it verbatim. The logo is the space's own mark, recovered from the same page.
'CT Makerspaces Map' My Map attached to the superseded site. Coordinates are the 'Spark Makerspace' pin, transcribed from its KML, not geocoded.

Own site: 7 Union Street; sliding-scale membership $30–$65/month; facility access 6am–10pm daily; public meetups with a $5 suggested donation, open to ages 12 and up with under-18s accompanied by an adult.
